text.div: The U.S. Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC) Race and Ethnicity Code System (CDCREC) is a federal data standard for maintaining, collecting, reporting, exchanging race and ethnicity data. CDCREC is based on the U.S. Office of Management and Budget (OMB) Statistical Policy Directive No 15 (SPD 15) Revision, 1997.
